# monotaur_role_assignment (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur role assignment by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_role_assignment" "ci_bot_editor" {
  id = "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the role assignment to look up.

### Read-Only

- `assigned_at` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the role was assigned.
- `role_id` (String) The ID of the role that is assigned.
- `service_account_id` (String) The ID of the service account the role is assigned to.
